role: Snapshot tests for ContributorChip (HRV/sleep/vitals/load variants and loading/noData/buildingBaseline/locked/compact states) and BreathingMandalaView, plus a layout test that four chips fit a 375pt iPhone row.

flags.text: hosted() injects a real RRCollector() whose convenience init resolves AppDependencies.current singletons (settings, archive, HealthKitManager) and builds a PolarManager, so each snapshot test constructs app-host collection objects that share global state with the running app host.

units.does: Wraps a view with a fresh RRCollector() and SettingsManager.shared in the environment.
Pins the chip to 88pt width and hosts it.
Lays out four chips (HRV, sleep, vitals elevated, load building) in an 8pt-spaced HStack and asserts the fitted width ≤ 375 − 36 = 339pt.
units.entry: XCTest test method, discovered by name and run by the XCTest runner in the Emuqu app host

units.does: Renders the HRV chip '45 ms' trend up at 88pt and asserts it matches reference 'chip-hrv' (fails when recording or blank).
